defect: a scan reset is muxed directly into a functional reset
rationale: Changing scan_mode_i or releasing scan_rst_ni can change selected_rst_ni asynchronously at the functional clock, defeating reset-release synchronization.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

mutation.description: Selected a raw scan reset through a mode mux immediately before a functional register reset.

labels.note: Both raw reset paths bypass local release synchronization and the selector can switch live.
